name: Baskerville
source:
In the early 2030s, an event named The Fall shook London and introduced humanity to Vornovians, extraterrestrial beings from Proxima Centauri. What began as a misunderstanding escalated into a human-Vornovian conflict, resolved after 18 months through diplomacy, allowing coexistence and collaboration. Peace has endured for two decades, with Vornovians becoming integral parts of Earth's society.

Sherr-Lok, a detective with unconventional methods, aids the Doyle District Detective Bureau and offers private investigative services. Watt-Sun, once a frontline soldier, battled a decade of homelessness and PTSD before Sherr-Lok mentored him into becoming a detective.

Sherr-Lok and Watt-Sun's next journey sees them navigate a mysterious case involving Peter Baskerville, heir to the infamous Baskerville Hall, just mere months after the death of his uncle. Threats against Peter's life provide the backdrop for a captivating narrative filled with escaped prisoners, shadowy organisations, and a supposed curse that has lasted over 200 years. Sherr-Lok and Watt-Sun take the case and find themselves in a fight to find the truth behind the long-running mystery.

[From [url=https://dragoncog.itch.io/baskerville]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2030年代初，一场名为“堕落”的事件震撼了伦敦，并将人类引入了来自比邻星的外星生物沃尔诺维亚人。最初的误会升级为人类与沃尔诺维亚的冲突，18个月后通过外交解决，实现了共存与合作。和平已经持续了二十年，沃尔诺维亚人已成为地球社会不可分割的一部分。

谢尔·洛克（Sherr-Lok）是一名采用非传统方法的侦探，协助多伊尔地区侦探局并提供私人调查服务。瓦特·孙（Watt-Sun）曾经是一名前线士兵，在谢尔·洛克（Sherr-Lok）的指导下成为一名侦探之前，他与无家可归和创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）作了十年的斗争。

谢尔·洛克和瓦特·孙的下一个旅程将是他们处理一个涉及彼得·巴斯克维尔的神秘案件，彼得·巴斯克维尔是臭名昭著的巴斯克维尔庄园的继承人，而就在他的叔叔去世几个月后。彼得的生命受到威胁，这为引人入胜的故事提供了背景，其中充满了越狱囚犯、神秘组织和持续200多年的所谓诅咒。谢尔·洛克和瓦特·孙接手此案，并发现自己陷入了一场寻找长期谜团背后真相的战斗中。

[来自[url=https://dragoncog.itch.io/baskerville]Itch.io[/url]]
